title: Player & Team Administration
subtitle: Save players, teams and groups once — reuse them in every format.

hero.alt: The Players hub listing every saved player with search and filters

intro: Type a name once. Players, teams and groups are saved on the device and available in every mode, so setting up next week's session is a matter of picking people rather than typing them again.
It all works with no account and no signal — the library lives on the phone. When you do need it elsewhere, it exports to an Excel file and imports back.
bestfor: Clubs running the same faces every week
Events big enough that typing names at the net is not viable
Anyone who has re-entered the same twelve players four sessions running

sections.title: Players
sections.text: The searchable library of everyone you have ever entered, with what they belong to and what they have played.

cards.p: Every saved player in one list, filterable by name, team or tournament. Each entry shows how many teams, groups and tournaments they belong to.
cards.alt: The Players hub with the full searchable player list

cards.p: Scroll the library, edit or delete inline. This is the screen a club with sixty members actually lives in.
cards.alt: The full scrollable list of saved players

cards.p: Add a name — or take a suggested one — and optionally assign them to existing teams and groups at the moment of creation.
cards.alt: The create player sheet with name and optional team and group assignment

cards.p: What they belong to and what they have played, with everything editable from the same screen.
cards.alt: A player detail page showing their teams, groups and tournament history

cards.p: Put an existing player into an existing team without going through either hub — the assignment works from both ends.
cards.alt: A dialog assigning a player to an existing team

cards.p: During tournament setup, Add Existing Players opens the same library with search and group filter, and a counter tracking the spots left.
cards.alt: Adding an existing player to a team during setup

sections.title: Teams
sections.text: Pre-formed pairs and squads, stored with their rosters, ready to drop into any bracket format.

cards.p: Every saved team, browsable by name, player or tournament, each showing its player count and group membership.
cards.alt: The Teams hub listing saved teams with their player counts

cards.p: Name it, link it to existing player profiles, and assign it to one or more groups. It is immediately available in Add Existing Teams across every bracket mode.
cards.alt: The create team sheet with name, players and group assignment

cards.p: The roster, the groups it belongs to and the events it has played, all editable in place.
cards.alt: A team detail page showing its roster and history

sections.title: Groups
sections.text: A club, a venue, a Tuesday night regulars list. Groups are how you avoid scrolling past everyone else to find the eight people who actually turned up.

cards.p: Every group you have made, with what belongs to it. A player or a team can be in several at once.
cards.alt: The Groups hub listing saved groups

cards.p: Name it and add the players and teams that belong to it — a club, a venue, or a recurring series.
Its members, and the filter that makes setup fast: pick the group during tournament setup and add its people in a few taps.
cards.alt: A group detail page listing its players and teams

feature_list_text: Includes exporting your players, groups and teams to an Excel file and importing them back — on this device or another one.
feedback: Managing a club roster in TournaQ and hitting a limit? Tell us what you are trying to do.
